title: Unit Converter
description:
**Goal:** Convert between units using one function per conversion.
```
Enter a distance in km: 10
10 km = 6.21371 miles
Enter a temperature in °C: 25
25 °C = 77 °F
Enter a weight in kg: 70
70 kg = 154.324 lb
```
hints: °F = °C × 9 / 5 + 32. Write `9.0 / 5.0`, not `9 / 5`: two whole numbers divide to a whole number, so `9 / 5` is 1.
Each conversion is the same three steps as the distance: ask, read into a `double`, print the call's result.
requirements: `main` only reads input, calls functions, prints
